question: In India, Garibi Hatao and attainment of self - reliance was the main objective of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fifth Five Year Plan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Fifth Five Year Plan** (1974-1979) of India aimed at **removing poverty (Garibi Hatao)** and achieving **self-reliance**.
 
• It was formulated and launched by the then Prime Minister **Indira Gandhi**.
 
• The plan focused on employment, poverty alleviation, and justice.
 
• It included programs such as the **Minimum Needs Programme** and the **Twenty Point Programme**.
 
• The plan was terminated in 1978 by the newly elected government, which introduced the **Rolling Plan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **First Five Year Plan** (1951-1956) focused on the primary sector, especially agriculture.
 
• The **Third Five Year Plan** (1961-1966) aimed at establishing a self-reliant economy and independent growth.
 
• The **Seventh Five Year Plan** (1985-1990) focused on rapid growth in food grains production, increased employment opportunities, and productivity.
 
• The Five Year Plans in India were centralized and integrated national economic programs aimed at achieving specific goals.
 
• The Planning Commission of India was responsible for formulating and implementing these plans until it was replaced by the NITI Aayog in 2015.
